review.imagery: Root visually reviewed all 19 scoped original website resources. Fifteen selected gallery entries include three undated Souks built-area photographs and twelve proposed community/interior renders. The official 8 August 2024 Souks press article corroborates partial handover at that time, without establishing completion of the whole master community or a capture date for these photographs. Generic lifestyle portrait, banner and duplicate vertical living render were excluded. Interiors remain phase-unspecified concepts.
review.floorPlans: Root reviewed all six PDF indexes, all 66 delivered complete sheets and every visible unit area panel. RD1 has 22 individual net/gross tables. Sawa has three sample tables, Darb six tables on three whole paired spreads, Hamsa eight tables including repeated mirror pages. Suroor samples omit individual total areas. Its four labelled bedrooms conflict with the three-bedroom heading, and the Hamsa final unit/key-plan marker conflicts. Originals retain notices, source PDFs, physical-page links and byte/hash receipts.
review.location: Root read the full current web map, complete Souks, Sawa, Suroor and Darb regional sheets, phase master plans and the Darb regional numerical panel at high resolution. Current and earlier journey estimates remain explicitly qualified. No surveyed entrance, kilometre distance or precise building coordinate inferred.
review.provenance: Normal-GET dated URL/byte/SHA256 receipts cover six original research PDFs, official HTML, Souks handover press context and all 19 original website resources. Broker and portal hosting labels remain honest. Protected identity and existing commercial text are preserved.

unavailable: Suroor individual sample total areas, every master-community unit revision, confirmed final finishes, photograph capture dates, surveyed phase-specific visitor entrances, live routes and kilometre journeys remain unavailable or unverified. Suroor bedroom and Hamsa unit-marker conflicts require contracted-plan confirmation.
